rationale: Both the judge-facing contribution.md and the user-facing final message name Raman et al. (2026) 'White-Bear Steering' explicitly, describe the same WSB directed_modulation bench-item contrast, the same cosine-0.80 overlap, and frame the novelty claim identically (self-authored prompts, not tied to one source). However, the message gives the user two extra pieces of context not present in contribution.md (Raman's own reported k=6 optimal dose, and Henry (2026)'s 'concept allocation zone' as the rationale for the layer band) while omitting contribution.md's citation of Panickssery et al. (2024) CAA — a mix of telling the user more on some points and less on another relative to the judge.
